content:
Nora: Kicking off CitrineHealth private onboarding thread. Quick triage: split-tunnel networking, cross-account CloudWatch access, KMS alias + rotation plan, and SIEM ingestion. Flag any immediate blockers.
Ethan: Heads-up on split-tunnel: customer wants internal traffic over VPN and internet traffic direct. We need them to push route 0.0.0.0/0 except our collector CIDRs. They must avoid asymmetric routing for agent callbacks.
Priya (Customer): our network folk plan to do split-tunnel. Can you send the collector CIDRs and expected callback ports?
Maya: collector list: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.0/28. Control-plane callback uses TCP 8443 and our agent heartbeat uses TCP 5222. WireGuard optional: UDP 51820.
Victor: Security: for KMS we require alias prefix alias/redwood/citrine and grant kms:Decrypt to role arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/redwood-priv-svc. If they have automatic rotation, schedule must be communicated 48h prior.
Priya (Customer): can you paste a minimal key policy to attach?
Maya: Minimal snippet below (attach as plain policy body in their console):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/redwood-priv-svc" },
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Nora: Observability note: Citrine requested SIEM forward to Sumo Logic. Our pipeline sends JSON lines to their collector; verify their collector expects UTF-8 JSONL and they whitelist our IPs.
Priya (Customer): Sumo team asks if we sign events or if we use TLS mutual auth.
Ethan: We use TLS server-side only. If they require mTLS, we need a special collector and a support ticket. Default is TLS to their endpoint on 443.
onboard-bot: onboarding-status: network(pending), kms(pending), iam(in-progress), logs(pending). See https://redwood.internal/onboard/3320009999/status
Victor: IAM: cross-account role name must be exact `RedwoodPrivateAccess`. Common failure is appending env suffixes. Also ensure their trust policy allows sts:AssumeRole from 444555666777.
Priya (Customer): noted. I'll request role creation and KMS policy today. ETA: EOD.
Maya: One gotcha we saw: S3 bucket with Object Lock enabled causes our ingestion to fail. Please confirm the bucket has Object Lock off.
Nora: Renewal signal: billing has a medium-risk flag due to expected heavy token usage next month. If onboarding is blocked for >48h we should mark renewal-risk and ping AM.
Priya (Customer): I'll confirm Object Lock and post the bucket name here.
Ethan: After firewall changes, I'll run smoke tests: `curl -v https://collector.example:443/health` and `nc -vz 203.0.113.5 8443`. Share the collector hostname and I'll run them.
Maya: I'll update the quickstart doc to explicitly call out split-tunnel requirements and the KMS alias pattern. Small doc change will save time.
Nora: Action summary: 1) Priya to request split-tunnel and whitelist 203.0.113.0/28 & 198.51.100.0/28 (Priya) 2) Create role `RedwoodPrivateAccess` and share ARN (Priya) 3) Create alias `alias/redwood/citrine` and attach KMS policy (Priya + Victor) 4) Confirm Sumo collector endpoint and Object Lock off (Priya) 5) Post firewall window for tests (Priya) 6) We monitor renewal-risk and escalate if blocked >48h (Nora).
billing-bot: alert: account shows 2.4x forecasted usage; consider watchlist.
Priya (Customer): firewall window tonight 01:30 UTC. I'll update once done.
Nora: thanks team. Reconvene after firewall window or earlier if blocker. :white_check_mark:
